core.headline: Mill Cottage, Riverside Lane, Yalding ME18
core.summary: A detached cottage dating from c.1850 with garden to the riverbank in Yalding. Wood-burning stove, exposed beams and driveway parking. The ground floor flooded from the River Beult in December 2013 and February 2020.
core.listing:
Mill Cottage is a detached cottage dating from c.1850, offering three bedrooms and a garden to the riverbank in Yalding. The property has a wood-burning stove and exposed beams.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms. One reception room has a wood-burning stove. The kitchen is on the ground floor. There are two bathrooms.

The first floor has three bedrooms.

The garden extends to the riverbank of the River Beult.

Yalding is a village with a pub and primary school.

Offers in Excess of £575,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band E (Maidstone Borough Council). EPC rating E. Construction: Standard. Mains electricity and water (metered). Sewerage: septic tank. Heating: oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known. Flooding: the ground floor flooded from the River Beult in December 2013 and February 2020; flood doors and non-return valves fitted 2021; insured through a Flood Re-backed policy.
